clue.text: A spider with a restless afterlife

indicators.note: restless suggests constant movement, so these letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A spider, together with a soul that cannot settle in the hereafter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'restless' rearranges ASPIDER plus the second A into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Paradise is heaven, the blissful afterlife promised to the righteous.

clue.text: Check tendency to turn up

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a tide is a trend or tendency, as in the tide of opinion

explanation.surface: Someone advised to curb a habit that keeps recurring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to turn up' reverses TIDE, which reads upwards in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: To edit a text is to check and correct it before publication.

clue.text: This report makes rugby players nearly weep

parts.note: RU is Rugby Union, the fifteen-a-side code of rugby

indicators.note: nearly means the word falls just short, losing its final letter

parts.note: to mourn is to weep for the dead

explanation.surface: A news report so upsetting that a rugby team almost cries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nearly' drops the last letter of MOURN to give MOUR.
explanation.definitionFit: A rumour is an unverified report passed from person to person.

clue.text: Drawing at end of day is incomplete

parts.note: a sketch is a rough drawing

indicators.note: end of picks out the final letter of the word day

explanation.surface: A drawing finished only at the close of the day is still unfinished.
explanation.definitionFit: Sketchy describes something rough and lacking detail, hence incomplete.

clue.text: Like heartless senator, who supports the nomination

parts.note: as means like, in the sense of in the same way

indicators.note: heartless removes the central letter of the word senator

explanation.surface: A cold-hearted senator backing a candidate for office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' removes the middle A from SENATOR, leaving SENTOR.
explanation.definitionFit: An assentor is one who formally agrees to or seconds a nomination, as on electoral papers.

clue.text: What could be heard nearby? A carol (old) I arranged

indicators.note: arranged, as music is arranged, signals the letters being set in a new order

explanation.surface: A musician has rearranged an old carol, perhaps for a broadcast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' rearranges ACAROLOLDI to make the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Local radio stations broadcast to a small area, so they can be heard only nearby.

clue.text: A spiritualist has reduced my staff

indicators.note: reduced means cut short, so the staff synonym loses its last letter

parts.note: a stick is a staff or walking cane

explanation.surface: A medium complains that her staff has been cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reduced' drops the K from STICK to leave STIC.
explanation.definitionFit: A mystic is a person seeking spiritual truth through contemplation, a kind of spiritualist.

clue.text: Lie next to cruel lot and appeal for another's sympathy

indicators.note: next to places the lie synonym beside the cruel lot one, after it

parts.note: a cruel lot or fate is hard luck
a story is a fib or lie

explanation.surface: Someone telling a fib about their misfortune to win pity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'next to' sets STORY after HARD LUCK.
explanation.definitionFit: A tale of woe told to win sympathy or money is called a sob story of this kind.

clue.text: See 1
World sailor, a thoroughly reliable person

definitions.meaning: an idiom for a decent, dependable, unpretentious person

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase, from the Gospel of Matthew, means a person of great kindness and reliability.

clue.text: See 10
Chopper needed for pitman caught inside

indicators.note: inside places the abbreviation within the pitman synonym

parts.note: a pitman works in a coal pit, a miner
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A helicopter is needed to rescue a trapped miner.
explanation.definitionFit: A mincer is a kitchen device that chops meat finely, so a chopper.

clue.text: President has haircut up in prison

indicators.note: in places the hair pieces within the prison synonym

parts.note: can is slang for prison
the word splits into hair, taken as written, and cut

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word reads from the bottom upwards

parts.note: the cut half of the word: to mow is to cut grass

explanation.surface: A head of state is given a haircut while behind bars.
explanation.walkthrough: The single word 'haircut' supplies two pieces, with 'up' turning the cut synonym in this down entry. 'President' means one who presides over a meeting, not a head of state.
explanation.definitionFit: A chairwoman presides over a meeting, and to preside is what a president does.

clue.text: Yokel embraces tart uneasily, a rare achievement

indicators.note: embraces means the yokel synonym wraps around the other letters

parts.note: a hick is an unsophisticated country person, a yokel

indicators.note: uneasily suggests discomfort, so the letters of tart are shuffled

explanation.surface: A country bumpkin awkwardly hugs a floozy, which is quite a feat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tart' tempts as a pastry or a loose woman, but 'uneasily' marks it as letters to shuffle, which the yokel then 'embraces'.
explanation.definitionFit: A hat trick, three successes in a row (three wickets or goals), is a rare feat.

clue.text: Penalty for coins being found outside North America

indicators.note: being found outside means the coins synonym wraps around the abbreviation

parts.note: pence are British coins

explanation.surface: A fine for coins discovered beyond American shores.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being found outside' wraps the coins around NA. Pence are British pennies; 'for' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Penance is self-punishment done to atone for wrongdoing, a penalty.

clue.text: Affects more than one business

definitions.meaning: to concern something is to affect or involve it
... in the plural are firms or businesses

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb meaning touches or involves and a plural noun meaning firms.

clue.text: It's grand to make many holes in a hot plate

parts.note: G is short for grand, a thousand pounds
to riddle is to pierce with many holes, as with bullets

explanation.surface: A cook boasts of perforating a hotplate.
explanation.definitionFit: A griddle is a flat iron plate heated for cooking.

clue.text: Meat cut up first, flambé in the middle

indicators.note: first means the flambé letters come before the cut-up synonym
in the middle takes the letters of flambé between its first and last

parts.note: to chop is to cut up

explanation.surface: Instructions for cooking meat: dice it, then flame it halfway through.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the middle' takes LAMB from flambé; 'first' puts it ahead of CHOP.
explanation.definitionFit: A lamb chop is a cut of meat from a young sheep.

clue.text: Re Garbo novel, I'm amazed!

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters are made into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A gasp of astonishment at a novel about Greta Garbo.
explanation.definitionFit: Begorra is an Irish exclamation of surprise, an oath like by God.

clue.text: Make hostile sergeant different

indicators.note: different signals the letters of sergeant made into something else

explanation.surface: An order to turn a sergeant against his men.
explanation.definitionFit: To estrange is to alienate, turning a friend into a stranger or enemy.

clue.text: Odour of nets suspended over church

indicators.note: over in a down clue places the first piece above the second
suspended means hung up, so in this down clue the word is read upwards

explanation.surface: A smell from fishing nets hung up above the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suspended' reverses NETS to STEN; 'over' sets it above CH.
explanation.definitionFit: A stench is a strong unpleasant smell, a foul odour.

clue.text: Mr Ball retreats into the enclosure, which is rough

indicators.note: into places the reversed letters inside the enclosure synonym

parts.note: a sty is an enclosure for pigs

indicators.note: retreats means goes backwards, so the pieces are read in reverse

parts.note: taken as written, the abbreviated title
O resembles a ball in shape

explanation.surface: A Mr Ball backs into the pigpen on a stormy day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retreats' reverses MRO to ORM; 'into' puts it in STY.
explanation.definitionFit: Stormy weather or seas are rough and turbulent.

clue.text: Panama is different than us!

indicators.note: different signals the letters of than us rearranged

explanation.surface: A remark about how unlike us the people of Panama are.
explanation.definitionFit: A Panama is a straw hat worn against the sun.

clue.text: Withdraw your money and settle the score

definitions.meaning: read literally, to recover the funds that belong to you

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to take revenge, while the literal reading is recovering what is yours.

clue.text: See 23
To be swallowing it would be a mouthful

indicators.note: swallowing means the first word takes the second inside it

explanation.surface: Something so large that swallowing it would fill the mouth.
explanation.definitionFit: A bite is a piece taken by the mouth, a mouthful of food.

clue.text: Knock-on effect repaired in each Cortina

indicators.note: repaired, as of a car fixed, signals the letters put together anew

explanation.surface: A ripple of consequences after a fix on every Ford Cortina.
explanation.walkthrough: 'repaired' rearranges INEACHCORTINA. The Cortina was a popular British Ford car.
explanation.definitionFit: A chain reaction is a series of events each causing the next, a knock-on effect.

clue.text: See 25
